scenarios.name: sacrifice-creature-offers-one-mana-of-any-color
scenarios.why: 'Sacrifice a creature: Add one mana of any color' means the mana ability must offer every one of the five colors as a selectable output; sacrificing the Bears must put it in the graveyard. The full five-color offer is the Oracle-derived check; the cost is auto-paid here because the Bears is the only legal sacrifice, so the wheel is the only pending decision.

scenarios.name: sacrifice-creature-picks-one-named-colour
scenarios.why: 'Sacrifice a creature: Add one mana of any color' lets the activator choose the colour; sacrificing the Bears and choosing red must put a red mana in the pool.

scenarios.name: no-other-creature-no-offer
scenarios.why: With no other creature available the creature-sacrifice cost cannot be paid, so the mana ability is not offered.
